note: 突发事件 100 条（《第三轮设计》第四节）。人设：工作两年的上班族，白天上班、晚上练它，一个人租房，没有室友。频率按最新确认：上一个结果确认结束后累计 8 分钟活跃游玩时间，可在当前存档改为 15 分钟或关闭；整游戏最小化或明确暂停停表，失焦和游戏内 AI 程序隐藏不停表；到期遇冲突时，冲突结束后留出 30 秒。stage = [最低阶段, 最高阶段]；month = [起始年月, 结束年月]（可省略）；when = 额外条件（night=00:00–06:00, day=09:00–18:00, cards2=至少两张卡, bills=房租电费已开始, training=最近 30 秒在训练, money1000=钱包≥¥1000）。effects：money=加减钱（负数为花费，钱不够时该选项变灰）；samples=给当前题库加题；noise=给当前题库加错题；pause=训练暂停秒数；boost=[倍率, 秒数] 训练加速；persona=[轴, 变化]（温度/玩心/主见）；flag=写一个标记。requires = 需要先有某个标记（玩家自己做过的事）。当前阶段已满足条件的池抽完后再循环，新解锁事件优先；永久历史与选择标记保留。

events.title: 房租怎么转
events.body: 老王在 YY 上说：「交租日我会发转账卡，钱够就转，不够也可以先转一部分。电费另外算。」
events.bodyEn: Old Wang on YY: "I will send a transfer request on rent day. Pay in full or send part first. Electricity is separate."

choices.label: 记住了，去 YY 转账
choices.result: 交租时打开房东聊天，点转账卡或「￥ 转账」。
choices.resultEn: When rent is due, open the landlord chat and use the request card or Transfer button.

events.title: 周六加班
events.body: 经理在部门群里 @所有人：「这周六项目上线，大家辛苦一下。」
events.bodyEn: Your manager in the team chat: "Launch this Saturday. Thanks for pitching in, everyone."

choices.label: 去加班
choices.result: 加班费到手，电脑一天没人管。
choices.resultEn: Overtime pay in; the PC sat alone all day.

choices.label: 说家里有事
choices.result: 经理回了个「嗯」。周一有点尴尬。
choices.resultEn: The manager replies "OK". Monday will be awkward.

events.title: 楼下来敲门
events.body: 楼下阿姨上来敲门：「小伙子，你屋里嗡嗡响一晚上了，我家天花板都在震。」
events.bodyEn: The lady downstairs knocks: "Young man, your room's been humming all night. My ceiling is shaking."

choices.label: 给机箱垫块泡沫
choices.result: 淘货买了块减震垫，嗡嗡声小多了。
choices.resultEn: A ¥300 damping pad from Taohuo. The hum is much quieter.

events.title: hongmengos 10 强制更新
events.body: 下班回来，屏幕上写着「正在升级到 hongmengos 10，请勿关机 27%」。
events.bodyEn: Home from work, the screen says "Upgrading to hongmengos 10. Do not turn off your PC. 27%".

choices.label: 等它升完
choices.result: 升完了，显卡驱动要重装。
choices.resultEn: Done. The GPU driver needs reinstalling.

choices.label: 拔电源回滚
choices.labelEn: Pull the plug and roll back
choices.result: 回滚成功，但有个数据文件坏了。
choices.resultEn: Rolled back, but one data file got corrupted.

events.title: 妈打来电话
events.body: 妈：「吃饭了没？一个人在外面别老点外卖。你那电脑别整宿开着，费电。」
events.bodyEn: Mum: "Have you eaten? Don't live on takeaway. And don't leave that computer on all night, it eats power."

choices.label: 聊半小时
choices.result: 挂电话时，她又叮嘱了三遍早点睡。
choices.resultEn: Before hanging up she says go to bed early three more times.

choices.label: 说在忙，晚点回
choices.labelEn: Say you're busy, call back later
choices.resultEn: She says "OK, OK." You don't call back.

events.title: 小区停电
events.body: 楼道贴了通知：今天 14:00–17:00 线路检修停电。
events.bodyEn: A notice in the stairwell: power off for line work today, 14:00–17:00.

choices.label: 认了
choices.result: 下午三小时，电脑一声不吭。

choices.label: 买个 UPS
choices.result: 山特 UPS 撑了半小时，之后还是停了，但存档保住了。
choices.resultEn: The UPS lasts half an hour. Training still stops, but nothing is lost.

events.title: 360 要清理
events.body: 「检测到 12.4 GB 垃圾文件，一键清理可提速 38%！」列表里有一个文件夹叫「训练数据」。
events.bodyEn: "12.4 GB of junk found. One click and your PC is 38% faster!" One of the folders is called "training data".

choices.label: 一键清理
choices.result: 电脑没变快，题库少了一截。
choices.resultEn: Not faster. Some questions are gone.

events.title: 老同学来蹭饭
events.body: 咸鱼本鱼：「我出差路过你那儿，晚上一起撸串？」
events.bodyEn: Salted Fish: "Passing through on a work trip. Skewers tonight?"

choices.label: 去
choices.result: 喝到十一点，聊的全是大学宿舍的事。
choices.resultEn: Drinks till eleven, all dorm stories.

events.title: 显卡 89°C
events.body: 鲁大师弹窗：「显卡温度过高，可能影响硬件寿命！」
events.bodyEn: Master Lu: "GPU temperature too high. Hardware life may be affected!"

choices.label: 开空调
choices.result: 温度降到 72°C，电费多了一点。
choices.resultEn: Down to 72°C. A little more on the bill.

choices.label: 开窗，继续跑
choices.result: 降频跑了一阵，有几题算错了。
choices.resultEn: It throttled for a while; a few answers came out wrong.

events.title: 包邮的硅脂
events.body: 淘货推送：「信越 7921 硅脂 100 元包邮，显卡降温 10 度！」
events.bodyEn: Taohuo: "Shin-Etsu 7921 paste, ¥100 shipped. Cools your GPU by 10 degrees!"

events.title: 凌晨两点
events.body: 明早九点要打卡。屏幕上它还在练，进度条走到一半。
events.bodyEn: You clock in at nine. On screen it is still training, the bar half full.

choices.label: 去睡觉
choices.result: 关了显示器，风扇声陪你睡着。
choices.resultEn: Monitor off. The fans hum you to sleep.

choices.label: 再看一轮
choices.resultEn: You yawn all through work the next day.

events.title: 表姐要拼单
events.body: 表姐：「我在拼多多看中个拼团，帮我看看划不划算？」
events.bodyEn: Cousin: "I found a group buy on Pinduoduo. Can you check if it is worth it?"

choices.label: 帮她看看
choices.result: 表姐：「爱你！」又发来三个链接。
choices.resultEn: Cousin: "Love you!" Three more links follow.

choices.label: 装没看见
choices.resultEn: She asks again the next day.

events.title: 迅雷离线
events.body: 迅雷会员到期：「续费享离线下载加速，首月 500 元。」
events.bodyEn: Thunder VIP expired: "Renew for offline-download speedups. First month ¥500."

events.title: 同事问你周末干嘛
events.titleEn: A colleague asks about your weekend
events.body: 午饭时同事问：「你周末都宅家里干嘛？打游戏？」
events.bodyEn: At lunch a colleague asks: "What do you do at home every weekend? Games?"

events.title: 花呗账单
events.body: 「您本月花呗账单 ¥1,286，还款日 10 号。」上个月买的电源也在里面。
events.bodyEn: "Your Huabei bill this month: ¥1,286, due on the 10th." Last month's PSU is in there.

events.title: 高考作文题刷屏
events.body: 朋友圈都在晒今年高考作文题。有人说「让 AI 写一篇试试」。
events.bodyEn: Everyone is posting this year's gaokao essay prompts. Someone says "let an AI write one".

choices.label: 转发
choices.result: 评论区在怀念自己的高考。
choices.resultEn: The comments are all about people's own exams.

events.title: 1060 预售
events.body: 淘货：「GTX 1060 6G 预售，定金 100 抵 150！7 月 19 日发货。」
events.bodyEn: Taohuo: "GTX 1060 6GB pre-order. ¥100 deposit counts as ¥150! Ships 19 July."

events.title: 38 度
events.body: 下班回家，屋里闷得像蒸笼，机箱摸上去烫手。
events.bodyEn: Home from work, the room is a steamer and the case is hot to the touch.

choices.label: 空调开一整天
choices.labelEn: Leave the AC on all day
choices.resultEn: The bill will have something to say.

choices.label: 白天关机
choices.resultEn: It rests by day and trains at night.

events.title: 网吧淘汰卡
events.body: 喵鱼上有人甩卖：「网吧换机，GTX 970 十张，600 一张，不议价。」
events.bodyEn: On Miaoyu: "Café upgrade, ten GTX 970s, ¥600 each, firm."

choices.label: 买一张
choices.resultEn: The fan's a bit loud, but it works.

choices.label: 怕是矿卡
choices.resultEn: All gone by the next day.

events.title: 翻到一篇论文
events.body: 逛人工智能吧时，你看到一位研究生公开分享了组会论文。标题里的一个词，让你停下了滚轮。
events.bodyEn: While browsing the AI forum, you find a paper shared publicly by a graduate student. One word in its title makes you stop scrolling.

choices.label: 熬夜读完
choices.result: 看懂了三成，但有个技巧能用上。
choices.resultEn: You understood a third, but one trick is usable.

choices.label: 收藏，以后看
choices.result: 收藏夹又多了一篇「以后看」。

events.title: 宽带推销
events.body: 「您好，您的宽带可以提速到 50M，办理费 500 元，需改签两年合约……」
events.bodyEn: "Hello, you can upgrade to 50M for a ¥500 setup fee with a two-year contract…"

events.title: Pokémon GO 锁区
events.body: 同事在研究改 GPS 抓皮卡丘：「你懂电脑，帮我弄一下？」
events.bodyEn: A colleague wants to fake GPS to catch Pikachu: "You know computers. Help me?"

choices.label: 帮他折腾
choices.resultEn: A whole evening; his account got banned.

events.title: 电表跳了
events.body: 啪一声全屋黑了。老王在电话里：「你那屋功率太大，电闸扛不住！」
events.bodyEn: Click. Everything goes dark. Old Wang on the phone: "Your room draws too much. The breaker can't take it!"

choices.label: 出钱换粗线
choices.result: 电工来换了线，以后不怕跳闸。
choices.resultEn: An electrician rewires. No more trips.

events.title: 借钱
events.body: 咸鱼本鱼：「下个月发工资还你，先借我 500 应个急。」
events.bodyEn: Salted Fish: "Lend me ¥500 till payday? Bit of an emergency."

choices.label: 借
choices.result: 「够意思！」下个月他真还了，还多请了顿饭。
choices.resultEn: "You're a mate!" He pays it back next month, with dinner.

events.title: 要不要发帖晒一下
events.body: 你盯着曲线看了很久。要不要去人工智能吧发个帖，晒一下自己在家练的东西？
events.bodyEn: You stare at the curve a while. Post on the AI forum about what you're training at home?

choices.label: 发帖
choices.result: 有个研究生回帖，打包发了一批标好的题。
choices.resultEn: A grad student replies and sends a batch of labelled questions.

choices.label: 算了，低调
choices.result: 没发。曲线只有你一个人看。
choices.resultEn: No post. Only you see the curve.

events.title: 团建
events.body: 「周末部门团建去郊区漂流，AA 每人 150。」
events.bodyEn: "Team outing this weekend: rafting out of town, ¥150 each."

choices.label: 去
choices.result: 晒黑了一圈，跟同事熟了点。
choices.resultEn: Sunburnt, and a bit closer to the team.

choices.label: 请假
choices.result: 周一大家在聊你没听过的梗。
choices.resultEn: On Monday they share jokes you missed.

events.title: 蓝屏
events.body: 半夜一声「嘟」，屏幕蓝了：IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL。
events.bodyEn: A beep in the night and the screen turns blue: IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL.

choices.label: 重启，从上一版接着练
choices.result: 退回上一版，这一轮白练了。
choices.resultEn: Back to the last save; the round is lost.

choices.label: 查驱动
choices.result: 更新了驱动，之后更稳了。

events.title: 表姐的微商
events.body: 表姐：「帮我转发一下朋友圈呗，面膜买二送一！」
events.bodyEn: Cousin: "Repost my shop on Moments? Face masks, buy two get one free!"

choices.label: 转
choices.result: 三个同学点赞，一个同学屏蔽了你。
choices.resultEn: Three likes, and one classmate mutes you.

choices.label: 私下买一盒
choices.resultEn: She throws in an extra mask.

events.title: 同事借 U 盘
events.titleEn: A colleague borrows a USB stick
events.body: 同事：「借个 U 盘拷文件。」你的 U 盘里存着一份题库备份。
events.bodyEn: A colleague: "Can I borrow a USB stick?" Yours holds a backup of the question bank.

choices.label: 借，叮嘱别删
choices.result: 还回来时多了个病毒，杀掉了，丢了几条。
choices.resultEn: It comes back with a virus. Removed, but a few items lost.

events.title: 大鱼海棠
events.body: 《大鱼海棠》上映，咸鱼本鱼问：「周末去看不？」
events.bodyEn: Big Fish & Begonia is out. Salted Fish: "Cinema this weekend?"

choices.label: 去看
choices.result: 画面好看，故事见仁见智。

choices.label: 等网盘
choices.result: 迅雷：敏感资源，无法下载。

events.title: 电源啸叫
events.body: 电源发出高频的吱吱声，越听越刺耳。
events.bodyEn: The power supply whines at a pitch that grows harder to ignore.

choices.label: 戴耳机
choices.result: 某天电压一抖，有几题算错了。
choices.resultEn: One day the voltage dips; a few answers go wrong.

events.title: 她问你在干嘛
events.body: 晴雯：「你这几天下班都在干嘛？消息回得好慢。」
events.bodyEn: Qingwen: "What have you been doing after work? You're so slow to reply."

choices.label: 视频聊一会儿
choices.result: 她给你看了新买的猫爬架。
choices.resultEn: She shows you her new cat tree.

events.title: 奥运凌晨
events.body: 女排决赛开始了。你醒着，它也醒着。
events.bodyEn: The women's volleyball final begins. You're awake, and so is it.

choices.label: 看完再睡
choices.result: 赢了！你在屋里喊出声，楼下没敲门。
choices.resultEn: They win! You shout; nobody knocks.

choices.label: 让它练，自己睡
choices.result: 早上看新闻才知道赢了。
choices.resultEn: You learn they won from the morning news.

events.title: 有人收你的旧卡
events.body: 喵鱼私信：「你那张旧卡 800 出不出？我给我弟装 LOL。」
events.bodyEn: On Miaoyu: "Sell your old card for ¥800? It's for my brother's LoL."

choices.label: 留着
choices.resultEn: It still adds a little compute.

events.title: 老王查电表
events.body: 老王拿手电筒照着电表：「你这一个月用了别人三个月的电。」
events.bodyEn: Old Wang shines a torch at the meter: "You used three months' power in one."

choices.label: 解释在学东西
choices.result: 「学什么要这么多电？」他摇摇头走了。
choices.resultEn: "Studying what, with that much power?" He shakes his head and leaves.

events.title: 要出差一周
events.body: 「下周你去成都驻场一周，客户那边要人。」
events.bodyEn: "You're on site in Chengdu next week. The client needs someone."

choices.label: 去，远程开机
choices.result: 出差补助到手；回来发现自动标的题里有一堆错。
choices.resultEn: Travel allowance in; back home, the auto-labels are full of mistakes.

choices.label: 去，关机
choices.resultEn: A week off, then back to it.

events.title: 硬盘咔哒响
events.body: 机械硬盘时不时咔哒一声。HD Tune 扫出几个黄格子。
events.bodyEn: The hard disk clicks now and then. HD Tune shows a few yellow blocks.

choices.label: 先用着
choices.result: 一周后坏了几个扇区，丢了些题。
choices.resultEn: A week later some sectors fail; questions lost.

events.title: 老周问能不能借卡
events.titleEn: 老周 asks to borrow a card
events.body: 老周：「组里服务器卡烧了，导师催结果。你那张卡能借我两天不？」
events.bodyEn: 老周: "Our server's card burned out and my advisor wants results. Lend me yours for two days?"

choices.label: 借
choices.result: 他说回头学校有大文件帮你拷。
choices.resultEn: He says he'll copy big files for you on campus.

events.title: 小目标
events.body: 朋友圈都在定小目标。你在备忘录里写下自己的。
events.bodyEn: Everyone's setting "small goals". You type yours into a note.

choices.label: 今年让它学会说话
choices.labelEn: Teach it to talk this year

choices.label: 先挣一个亿
choices.result: 转发到群里，阿杰回了个 666。
choices.resultEn: You post it to the group. A-Jie replies 666.

events.title: 年中考评
events.body: HR：「请填写年中自评表，周五前交。」
events.bodyEn: HR: "Please fill in your mid-year self-review by Friday."

events.title: 表姐被骗了？
events.body: 表姐：「我收到短信说我中了一台 iPhone，要先交 200 手续费……真的假的？」
events.bodyEn: Cousin: "A text says I won an iPhone but need to pay a ¥200 fee first… real?"

choices.label: 让它看看
choices.result: 它答「是骗子」。你把这条也教进了题库。
choices.resultEn: It says "scam". You add the text to the question bank.

choices.label: 直接说骗子
choices.result: 表姐：「吓死我了，差点就转了。」

events.title: 宽带断了
events.body: 网断了。客服说片区光纤被挖断，预计明天修好。
events.bodyEn: No internet. Support says a dig cut the area's fibre; fixed tomorrow.

events.title: Titan X 上架
events.body: 淘货首页：TITAN X Pascal，¥9999。你看了很久。
events.bodyEn: Taohuo front page: TITAN X Pascal, ¥9,999. You stare at it a long time.

events.title: 风扇卡住
events.body: 机箱里咯噔一声，有个风扇不转了。
events.bodyEn: A clunk in the case. One fan has stopped.

choices.label: 拆开清灰
choices.resultEn: A ball of fluff. You don't even have a cat.

events.title: 她要来你城市
events.body: 晴雯：「国庆我去你那边玩两天，你有空吗？」
events.bodyEn: Qingwen: "I'm visiting your city over National Day. Free?"

choices.label: 当然有空
choices.result: 两天没开电脑，过得很快。
choices.resultEn: Two days without the PC. They fly by.

events.title: 电信诈骗新闻
events.body: 新闻：大学生被电信诈骗骗走学费。全国开始严打。
events.bodyEn: News: a student loses her tuition to a phone scam. A national crackdown begins.

choices.label: 多教它几条诈骗短信
choices.result: 垃圾短信题库多了一批新套路。
choices.resultEn: New scam patterns added to the spam bank.

choices.label: 转给家人看
choices.resultEn: Mum: "Got it, you be careful too."

events.title: 同事想跳槽
events.body: 同事小声：「听说百度在招机器学习，要不要一起投？」
events.bodyEn: A colleague whispers: "Baidu's hiring for machine learning. Apply together?"

choices.label: 投一份试试
choices.result: 一周后收到婉拒邮件：「需要硕士学历。」
choices.resultEn: A polite rejection a week later: "Master's degree required."

events.title: 驱动更新
events.body: GeForce Experience：「新驱动可用，游戏性能提升！」
events.bodyEn: GeForce Experience: "New driver available. Better game performance!"

choices.label: 能用就别动
choices.labelEn: If it works, don't touch it

events.title: iPhone 7 首发
events.body: 同事都在抢 iPhone 7。你的 4S 还能用。
events.bodyEn: Colleagues are scrambling for the iPhone 7. Your 4S still works.

choices.label: 换
choices.result: 亮黑色，三天就有划痕了。
choices.resultEn: Jet black. Scratched in three days.

events.title: 组里要做个分类功能
events.body: 经理：「客户想要个自动给工单分类的功能，你们谁懂点？」
events.bodyEn: Your manager: "The client wants tickets sorted automatically. Anyone know how?"

choices.label: 举手
choices.result: 你用业余时间做了个原型，经理请你吃了顿饭。
choices.resultEn: You build a prototype after hours; your manager buys you dinner.

events.title: 要涨房租
events.body: 老王：「下个月起涨 200，周边都涨了。」
events.bodyEn: Old Wang: "Up ¥200 from next month. Everyone round here is raising it."

choices.label: 认了
choices.result: 搬家太麻烦。下期房租加 ¥200，到了交租日再转。
choices.resultEn: Moving is a pain. Rent goes up ¥200 next period; pay it on rent day.

choices.label: 讲价
choices.result: 老王：「行，看你按时交，涨一百。」下期起加 ¥100，到了交租日再转。
choices.resultEn: Old Wang: "You pay on time. A hundred, then." Rent goes up ¥100 next period; pay on rent day.

events.title: 他要结婚了
events.body: 咸鱼本鱼：「兄弟，十月结婚，你必须来当伴郎！」
events.bodyEn: Salted Fish: "Getting married in October. You're my best man!"

choices.label: 去
choices.result: 挡了一晚上酒，份子钱也到位了。
choices.resultEn: You fend off drinks all night. Gift money delivered.

events.title: 机箱漏电
events.body: 摸机箱被电了一下，手指发麻。
events.bodyEn: You touch the case and get a tingle.

choices.label: 叫电工接地线
choices.result: 老房子没地线，现在有了。
choices.resultEn: The old flat had no earth. Now it does.

choices.label: 以后别碰
choices.result: 偶尔会莫名其妙掉一题。
choices.resultEn: Now and then an answer glitches.

events.title: 谷歌翻译换了神经网络
events.body: 新闻：谷歌翻译换成神经网络，错误少了六成。你看了半天。
events.bodyEn: News: Google Translate switches to a neural network, 60% fewer errors. You read it twice.

choices.label: 把这条新闻存下来
choices.result: 「整句读完再翻」，你记住了这句话。
choices.resultEn: "Read the whole sentence, then translate." You remember that.

events.title: 雷暴
events.body: 窗外打雷，灯闪了两下。
events.bodyEn: Thunder outside. The lights flicker twice.

choices.label: 赌一把
choices.result: 一个浪涌，存档坏了一点。
choices.resultEn: A surge; part of the save is corrupted.

events.title: 表姐要来借住
events.body: 表姐：「我来你城市面试，在你那挤两晚行不？」
events.bodyEn: Cousin: "Interview in your city. Can I crash for two nights?"

choices.label: 行，我睡沙发
choices.result: 她说你屋里一股热风，像住在吹风机里。
choices.resultEn: She says your flat feels like the inside of a hair dryer.

events.title: 年假
events.body: HR 提醒：你还有 5 天年假没休，年底清零。
events.bodyEn: HR: you have 5 days of leave left. They expire at year's end.

choices.label: 出去玩
choices.result: 去了趟厦门，鼓浪屿排了一小时队。
choices.resultEn: Xiamen. An hour's queue on Gulangyu.

events.title: 她生病了
events.body: 晴雯：「发烧了，一个人在宿舍好难受。」
events.bodyEn: Qingwen: "Got a fever. Feeling awful alone in the dorm."

choices.label: 订外卖送粥
choices.resultEn: "How did you know I wanted congee?"

choices.label: 多喝热水
choices.resultEn: She replies with a full stop.

events.title: 一条公开求助帖
events.body: 吧里有人发帖：「我的门控记忆总是练崩，学习率应该怎么调？」帖子还没人回复。
events.bodyEn: Someone posts publicly: "My gated-memory model keeps diverging. How should I change the learning rate?" There are no replies yet.

events.title: 内存条松了
events.body: 开机滴滴滴三声长鸣。
events.bodyEn: Three long beeps at boot.

choices.label: 拔下来擦金手指
choices.resultEn: A rub with an eraser. Fixed.

events.title: 阴阳师
events.body: 同事都在抽 SSR，拉你入坑。
events.bodyEn: Colleagues are pulling for SSRs and want you in.

events.title: 帖子下有人想买笔记
events.body: 有人在你发过的学习记录帖下留言：「你自己整理的标注笔记，能卖一份拷贝吗？200 块。」
events.bodyEn: Someone replies under the learning notes you posted: "Could I buy a copy of your annotation notes? ¥200."

choices.label: 卖一份拷贝
choices.result: 钱到了。不知道他拿去干嘛。
choices.resultEn: Paid. No idea what he wants it for.

events.title: 同事看到你的屏保
events.body: 同事路过你工位：「你这屏保是啥，一堆点连来连去的。」
events.bodyEn: A colleague passes your desk: "What's that screensaver? All dots and lines."

events.title: 信用卡提额
events.body: 「恭喜您，信用卡额度提升至 20000 元！」
events.bodyEn: "Congratulations, your credit limit is now ¥20,000!"

events.title: 国庆堵车
events.body: 高速堵成停车场，朋友圈全是堵车照。你在家。
events.bodyEn: Motorways jammed solid, Moments full of it. You're home.

choices.label: 宅七天
choices.result: 七天，它进步最快的一周。

events.title: 要不要转岗
events.body: 经理：「公司要成立数据组，你有兴趣吗？」
events.bodyEn: Your manager: "We're setting up a data team. Interested?"

choices.label: 去
choices.result: 白天也在跟数据打交道了。
choices.resultEn: Now it's data by day too.

choices.label: 留在原组
choices.resultEn: Business code by day, it by night.

events.title: 显卡花屏
events.body: 屏幕上出现一道道彩色条纹。
events.bodyEn: Coloured streaks across the screen.

events.title: 表姐开店了
events.body: 表姐：「我把微商做成淘宝店了！能帮我写点英文的商品介绍吗？」
events.bodyEn: Cousin: "My shop's on Taobao now! Help me with some English product descriptions?"

choices.label: 帮她
choices.result: 她硬塞了 200 块。那些句子也进了翻译题库。
choices.resultEn: She insists on ¥200. The sentences go into the translation bank.

events.title: 蓝瘦香菇
events.body: 满屏「蓝瘦，香菇」。你想试试它懂不懂。
events.bodyEn: "Lan shou, xiang gu" everywhere. You want to see if it gets it.

choices.label: 教它这个梗
choices.result: 它学会了用「香菇」表示难过。

choices.label: 算了
choices.resultEn: Nobody will say it next month.

events.title: 阶梯电价第三档
events.body: 电费单上写着：第三档，每度 0.83 元。
events.bodyEn: The bill says: third tier, ¥0.83 per kWh.

events.title: 有人公开征集翻译材料
events.body: 一位研究生在吧里公开征集翻译对照材料，说会在论文里致谢提供者。你想起自己存过的一些公开资料。
events.bodyEn: A graduate student publicly asks for parallel translation material and promises acknowledgements. You remember some public material you saved.

events.title: 硬盘满了
events.body: C 盘红了：剩余 200 MB。
events.bodyEn: C: is red. 200 MB free.

choices.label: 买 2T 移动硬盘
choices.result: 全挪过去，C 盘又蓝了。
choices.resultEn: Moved over. C: is blue again.

choices.label: 删点旧存档
choices.result: 腾出空间，也丢了点东西。

events.title: 饭局
events.body: 同事升职请客，KTV 续摊。
events.bodyEn: A colleague's promotion dinner, karaoke after.

events.title: 她想见你家人
events.titleEn: She wants to meet your family
events.body: 晴雯：「春节你带我回家吧？」
events.bodyEn: Qingwen: "Take me home for Spring Festival?"

choices.label: 好
choices.result: 你把这件事记在了日历上。
choices.resultEn: You put it in the calendar.

choices.label: 再想想
choices.resultEn: She doesn't bring it up again.

events.title: 双十一零点
events.body: 零点倒计时。购物车里有显卡、硬盘和给妈买的羽绒服。
events.bodyEn: Countdown to midnight. Cart: a GPU, a disk and a down jacket for Mum.

choices.label: 全买
choices.resultEn: Parcels pile up at the door.

choices.label: 只买羽绒服
choices.resultEn: Mum: "Wasting money." She never takes it off.

events.title: 光纤入户
events.body: 电信：「小区光纤改造完成，100M 包年 1200。」
events.bodyEn: Telecom: "Fibre's in. 100M for ¥1,200 a year."

choices.label: 办
choices.result: 下载大数据包不再熬夜。
choices.resultEn: No more all-nighters for big downloads.

events.title: 失眠
events.body: 躺在床上睡不着。屏幕的光从门缝透进来。
events.bodyEn: You can't sleep. The screen's glow leaks under the door.

choices.label: 起来跟它聊几句
choices.labelEn: Get up and talk to it
choices.result: 它回了一句你没教过的话。
choices.resultEn: It says something you never taught it.

events.title: 语音识别追平人类
events.body: 新闻：微软语音识别错误率追平人类速记员。
events.bodyEn: News: Microsoft's speech recognition matches human transcribers.

choices.label: 转到群里
choices.result: 大伟：「以后开会不用记纪要了。」
choices.resultEn: Da Wei: "No more meeting minutes then."

choices.label: 默默看完
choices.result: 你想：它什么时候能听懂我说话？
choices.resultEn: You wonder when it will understand your voice.

events.title: 相亲
events.body: 妈：「你王阿姨的女儿也在你那个城市，周末见一面？」
events.bodyEn: Mum: "Auntie Wang's daughter lives in your city. Meet her this weekend?"

choices.label: 我有对象了
choices.result: 妈愣了三秒：「谁啊？带回来看看。」
choices.resultEn: Mum pauses three seconds: "Who? Bring her home."

events.title: 电源炸了
events.body: 「砰」，一股焦味。电源烧了。
events.bodyEn: Bang. A burning smell. The power supply is dead.

events.title: 你的名字。
events.body: 朋友圈都在刷《你的名字。》。晴雯问你去不去看。
events.bodyEn: Everyone's posting about Your Name. Qingwen asks if you want to go.

events.title: 年终奖
events.body: 经理：「今年年终奖两个月，下周发。」
events.bodyEn: Your manager: "Two months' bonus this year. Paid next week."

choices.label: 全投进机房
choices.result: 钱到账，机房的单子还开着。
choices.resultEn: Paid in. The rack order is still open.

events.title: 老王来送饺子
events.body: 冬至，老王端来一盘饺子：「一个人在外面，吃点热乎的。」
events.bodyEn: Winter solstice. Old Wang brings a plate of dumplings: "On your own out here, have something warm."

choices.label: 请他进来坐
choices.result: 他看着机箱说：「这玩意儿，比我那台电视还热乎。」
choices.resultEn: He eyes the case: "Warmer than my telly."

events.title: 整栋楼跳闸
events.body: 跑到一半，整栋楼黑了。楼道里有人骂。
events.bodyEn: Mid-run, the whole building goes dark. Someone swears in the stairwell.

choices.label: 去机房租机柜
choices.labelEn: Rent a rack at a data centre
choices.result: 机器搬走了，屋里突然好安静。
choices.resultEn: The machines are gone. The flat is suddenly quiet.

choices.label: 晚上再跑
choices.resultEn: It sleeps by day and wakes at night.

events.title: Steam 冬促
events.body: Steam 冬促，阿杰在群里刷屏。
events.bodyEn: Steam winter sale. A-Jie floods the group.

events.title: 少一点循环，多一点注意力？
events.body: 你翻着自己的实验记录：如果少绕几圈，让每个词直接看向整句话，会怎么样？
events.bodyEn: Reading your own experiment notes, you wonder: what if each word could look straight at the whole sentence, with fewer recurrent steps?

choices.label: 把想法记下来
choices.result: 你在本子上画了几条交叉的线，准备自己试试。
choices.resultEn: You sketch crossing lines in your notebook, ready to try it yourself.

choices.label: 先多做几轮对照
choices.result: 先记下疑问，不急着下结论。
choices.resultEn: You keep the question open instead of jumping to a conclusion.

events.title: 年底了
events.body: 日历只剩几页。你翻了翻这一年的电费单。
events.bodyEn: A few pages left on the calendar. You flip through the year's power bills.

choices.label: 不算了
choices.resultEn: It won't come back either way.

events.title: 跨年计划
events.body: 晴雯：「跨年你还对着电脑吗？」
events.bodyEn: Qingwen: "Still at the computer on New Year's Eve?"

choices.label: 陪你跨年
choices.result: 她发来一张倒计时的截图。

events.title: 人民币跌破 6.9
events.body: 新闻：人民币跌破 6.9。淘货的显卡又涨了 200。
events.bodyEn: News: the yuan falls past 6.9. GPUs on Taohuo up another ¥200.

choices.label: 赶紧买
choices.resultEn: Up another ¥100 the next day. Lucky.

events.title: 同学聚会
events.body: 咸鱼本鱼：「年底同学聚会，你去不去？好几个都结婚了。」
events.bodyEn: Salted Fish: "Class reunion at year's end. Coming? Loads of them are married."

choices.label: 去
choices.result: 有人问你在干嘛，你说「写程序」。
choices.resultEn: Someone asks what you do. "Programming," you say.

choices.label: 不去
choices.resultEn: You're not in the group photo.

events.title: 键盘进水
events.body: 手一抖，咖啡洒了一键盘。
events.bodyEn: A slip, and coffee across the keyboard.

choices.label: 晾一晚上
choices.resultEn: The W key sticks a little now.

events.title: 快递放门口
events.body: 快递员：「你不在家，放门口了。」门口什么都没有。
events.bodyEn: Courier: "You weren't in, left it at the door." There's nothing at the door.

events.title: 公司断网
events.body: 公司断网一下午，大家都在摸鱼。
events.bodyEn: Office internet down all afternoon. Everyone's slacking.

choices.label: 手机上看它的日志
choices.labelEn: Check its logs on your phone
choices.result: 看到它答对了一道难题。
choices.resultEn: You see it got a hard one right.

events.title: 物业查违规电器
events.body: 物业挨家挨户查大功率电器。
events.bodyEn: Building management is going door to door checking high-power appliances.

choices.label: 装不在家
choices.resultEn: Half an hour sitting in the dark.

events.title: 家里寄来特产
events.body: 妈寄来一箱腊肉和一张纸条：「别老熬夜。」
events.bodyEn: Mum sends cured meat and a note: "Don't stay up so late."

choices.label: 拍照发给她
choices.resultEn: She sends a string of voice messages.

events.title: 鼠标双击
events.body: 鼠标开始单击变双击，标注的时候点错了好几次。
events.bodyEn: The mouse double-clicks on single clicks. Several labels went wrong.

choices.label: 将就
choices.result: 题库里混进了几条错题。
choices.resultEn: A few wrong labels slip in.

events.title: 楼下装修
events.body: 楼下装修，电钻从早响到晚，电压一跳一跳的。
events.bodyEn: Renovation downstairs. Drills all day; the voltage keeps dipping.

events.title: 工资到账
events.body: 「您的账户收到工资 ¥5,860.00。」
events.bodyEn: "Salary of ¥5,860.00 received."

choices.label: 拿一部分给它
choices.resultEn: The rest is rent and food.

events.title: 系统时间错了
events.body: 主板电池没电，开机时间变成了 2009 年。
events.bodyEn: The CMOS battery died. The clock says 2009.

events.title: 它在等你
events.body: 加班到十一点回家，屏幕还亮着。光标在闪。
events.bodyEn: Home at eleven after overtime. The screen is still on. The cursor blinks.
